question_results.question: List and briefly explain the six articles of faith in Islam. [6 marks]
question_results.student_answer: Belief in One God, Angels, Books, Prophets, Day of Judgement, Divine Decree
question_results.correct_answer: 1. Tawheed — Belief in the Oneness of Allah. 2. Malaika — Belief in Angels created from light. 3. Kutub — Belief in the Revealed Books (Torah, Psalms, Gospel, Quran). 4. Rusul — Belief in the Prophets from Adam to Muhammad (pbuh). 5. Yawm al-Qiyamah — Belief in the Day of Resurrection and Judgement. 6. Qadar — Belief in Divine Decree, that Allah has knowledge of all things.
